record.name: Fathom
record.one_liner: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes video meetings with a public API and MCP support.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free plan and generate API keys or create an OAuth app via the Fathom website.
record.api_note: The REST API covers meeting insights, summaries, transcripts, action items, and webhooks.

evidence.quote: Partners can register an OAuth app to be eligible for a future marketplace listing
All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.
Anyone can browse the API docs and start building!
This documentation describes Fathom's REST API.
Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server
